definition: fraction of years with positive output
longest consecutive run of zero-output years inside the window
caveat: runs at window boundaries are truncated, not complete spell lengths

definition: largest sum over three consecutive years / total output in the window
caveat: undefined for all-zero paths; descriptive concentration, not an excess-over-shuffling test

definition: sum of absolute adjacent-year changes / total output in the window
caveat: defined as zero for all-zero paths; measures fluctuation relative to output

definition: career age of maximum output within the window, earliest year on ties
caveat: undefined for all-zero paths; first-maximum convention affects flat careers

definition: OLS slope of log(1 + annual output) against career age within each path
caveat: descriptive direction of within-career change; not a causal effect
